comingSoon.title: Opening soon
comingSoon.body: IGS-Pharma, your online pharmacy in Belgium, is opening soon.

storefront.noProducts: There are no products here yet.
storefront.addToCartSoon: Ordering online will be possible soon.
storefront.untranslated: This text is not available in your language yet.
storefront.unavailable: The products are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
storefront.cartCount: {count, plural, =0 {Your cart is empty} one {# item in your cart} other {# items in your cart}}
storefront.howOrderText: Choose your products and place your order.
storefront.howCheckText: A pharmacist checks every order with a medicine before it is prepared.
storefront.howPickupText: We let you know when your order is ready at the pharmacy.
storefront.tagline: Online pharmacy in Belgium. Ordering online will open soon.
storefront.euLogo: EU common logo for online pharmacies
storefront.legalPending: The text of this page will follow.
storefront.medicineNotice: This is a medicine. Read the leaflet carefully and ask your pharmacist for advice.
storefront.searchPrompt: Search by name, brand or CNK code.
storefront.searchTooShort: Type at least 2 characters to search.
storefront.searchNoResultsInStock: No products in stock found for “{q}”.
storefront.searchNoResultsHint: Check the spelling, try a shorter word or browse the categories.
storefront.noProductsInStock: No products in stock in this category.
storefront.earlyAccessBanner: Early access: you are seeing the shop before it opens to everyone.
storefront.deliveryNote: Pickup at the pharmacy is free. Home delivery {price}, free from {amount}. Prices include VAT.
storefront.deliveryNoteNever: Pickup at the pharmacy is free. Home delivery {price}. Prices include VAT.

account.signUpIntro: With an account you can follow your orders later and manage your details.
account.forgotIntro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account belongs to it, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A few words in a row are long enough and easy to remember.
account.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address, for example name@example.be.
account.passwordTooShort: Your password must have at least {min} characters.
account.passwordTooLong: Your password can have at most {max} characters.
account.signUpCheckInbox: We have sent an e-mail to the address you entered. Click the link in that e-mail to use your account. No e-mail? Check your junk mail too.
account.forgotCheckInbox: If an account belongs to this address, you will get an e-mail with a link within a few minutes. The link is valid for 1 hour. No e-mail? Check your junk mail too.
account.signInFailed: The e-mail address or the password is not right.
account.signInNotVerified: Confirm your e-mail address first. We have sent you a new link.
account.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
account.resetLinkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
account.resetDoneBody: You have been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
account.verifyInvalidBody: The link has expired or was already used. Sign in with your e-mail address and password: we will then send you a new link.
account.verifyPendingBody: Click the link in the e-mail we sent you to confirm your e-mail address.
account.ordersUnavailable: Your orders can't be shown right now. Try again later.
account.ordersFreshBody: Your orders are personal data. Sign in again to see them.
account.profileIntro: Change the name we use for you and the language of the e-mails we send you.
account.languageHint: This does not change the language of the website.
account.resultProfileInvalid: Check your name: it cannot be empty or too long.
account.securityIntro: Change your password and sign out on other devices.
account.freshNeededBody: For your safety we ask you to sign in again before you change your password or request your data.
account.currentPasswordWrong: The current password is not right.
account.otherSessionsBody: Signed in somewhere you no longer use? Sign out everywhere except here.
account.otherSessionsDone: You have been signed out on your other devices.
account.privacyIntro: Choose what we may do with your data and ask the pharmacy for a copy of it or to erase it.
account.dataIntro: You can ask the pharmacy for a copy of your data, or to erase it. The pharmacy handles every request by hand and answers within one month.
account.requestAccess: Request a copy of my data
account.erasureNote: Erasure is a request, not an instant delete: the pharmacy has to keep some records by law, for example about medicines. We tell you what is erased and what is kept.
account.noRequests: You have not made any requests.
account.resultRequested: Your request has been sent. The pharmacy will answer within one month.
account.resultAlreadyOpen: You already have an open request of this kind.
account.resultFreshRequired: Sign in again first, then repeat your request.
account.legalPlaceholder: Placeholder text until the pharmacy's counsel supplies the final wording.

cart.title: Cart
cart.unavailable: Your cart is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
cart.totalNote: Indicative: prices are recalculated at checkout.
cart.resultLimit: You cannot order more of this product.
cart.resultUnavailable: This product is no longer available.
cart.resultFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
cart.resultShort: There is not enough stock for some products. Lower the quantity or remove them.
cart.deliveryInfo: Pickup at the pharmacy is free. Home delivery: {price}, VAT included.
cart.deliveryFreeNow: Pickup is free, and your order qualifies for free home delivery.
cart.deliveryMissing: Add {amount} more for free home delivery.
cart.fromListIntro: {count, plural, one {This product is} other {These # products are}} on the list you sent from the IGS-Pharma app. Prices and stock are today's.
cart.fromListAgain: Open My list in the IGS-Pharma app and tap “Order my list” again.
cart.fromListNone: None of these products can be ordered at the moment.
cart.fromListNote: Nothing is added until you press the button. You can change quantities in your cart.
cart.resultListAdded: Your list was added to your cart.
cart.resultListPartly: Your list was added to your cart, except products that can no longer be ordered.
cart.resultListFull: Part of your list was added: your cart is full. Remove a product to add the rest.

checkout.cancelled: This checkout was replaced by a newer one.
checkout.expired: Your reservation has expired. Start again to hold the stock again.
checkout.heldUntil: We keep these products for you until {time}.
checkout.pharmacistReview: Your order contains a medicine: a pharmacist checks it before it is prepared.
checkout.pickupOnly: You collect your order at the pharmacy.
checkout.name: Name
checkout.emailHint: We send the confirmation here, and a message when your order is ready.
checkout.placeOrderNote: You pay in the next step.
checkout.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example +32 470 12 34 56.
checkout.failureExpired: Your reservation has expired. Go back to your cart and start again.
checkout.failureCancelled: This checkout was replaced by a newer one. Go back to your cart.
checkout.failureNotFound: We can no longer find this checkout. Go back to your cart.
checkout.failureFeeChanged: The delivery price changed while you were ordering. Check the new amount and confirm again.
checkout.failureFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
checkout.pickupWhere: If you choose pickup, you collect your order here:
checkout.stepDelivery: How would you like to get your order?
checkout.deliveryFreeReached: Your order qualifies for free delivery.
checkout.addressNote: Only for home delivery. We deliver in Belgium only.
checkout.streetHint: With the box number, if any
checkout.streetTooLong: This is too long (120 characters at most).
checkout.streetInvalid: Do not use line breaks or control characters.
checkout.postalCodeInvalid: Enter a Belgian postal code of four digits.
checkout.cityTooLong: This is too long (80 characters at most).
checkout.cityInvalid: Do not use line breaks or control characters.

order.title: Thank you, we have received your order
order.unavailable: Your order cannot be shown right now. Please try again later.
order.paymentSoonDetail: Your order is registered but not paid yet. Paying is the next step, and it is not available yet.
order.payDetail: Your order is registered but not paid yet. You pay securely through Mollie with Bancontact, Visa, Mastercard or Apple Pay.
order.paymentProcessingDetail: Your bank is still confirming the payment. This page shows the new status once it is confirmed.
order.paymentFailed: The payment did not go through
order.paymentFailedDetail: Nothing was paid and the order was cancelled. Your cart is still ready.
order.stockShortDetail: Your payment was received. We are checking that everything is still in stock and will contact you.
order.paymentUnavailable: Payment is not possible right now
order.paymentUnavailableDetail: Try again in a few minutes. Nothing was paid.
order.pharmacistReview: A pharmacist checks your order before it is prepared.
order.trackingLink: Follow your parcel at the carrier
order.statusLinkBody: The link to this page lets you follow your order, even without an account or on another device. Don't share it with anyone.

earlyAccess.title: Early access
earlyAccess.intro: The IGS-Pharma webshop opens soon. With early access you can already see it, with your own account.
earlyAccess.signedOut: Sign in to ask for early access. No account yet? Create one first.
earlyAccess.afterSignUp: After you confirm your e-mail address, sign in and come back to this page.
earlyAccess.stateNone: You have not asked for early access yet.
earlyAccess.statePending: Your request of {since} is waiting for a decision. You will get an e-mail.
earlyAccess.stateApprovedUntilLaunch: You have early access until the webshop opens to everyone.
earlyAccess.stateExpired: Your early access ended on {at}. You can ask again.
earlyAccess.noteHint: For example why you would like early access. At most {max} characters.
earlyAccess.resultRequested: Thank you. Your request was sent; you will get an e-mail once it is decided.
earlyAccess.resultNotVerified: Confirm your e-mail address first, then ask again.
earlyAccess.resultRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
earlyAccess.resultPassRefused: You do not have early access at the moment.
earlyAccess.resultFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
